detaileddescription.para: Initializes a specific mailbox.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.
Device configuration structure containing required HW build data.
Physical address of the hardware in a Virtual Memory operating system environment. It is the Base Address in a stand alone environment.

briefdescription.para: Reads requested bytes from the mailbox.

detaileddescription.para: Reads requested bytes from the mailbox referenced by InstancePtr, into the buffer pointed to by the provided pointer. The number of bytes must be a multiple of 4 (bytes). If not, the call fails in an assert.
This function is non blocking.

InstancePtr
Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.
BufferPtr
Buffer to read the mailbox contents into, aligned to a word boundary.
RequestedBytes
Number of bytes of data requested.
BytesRecvdPtr
Memory that is updated with the number of bytes of data actually read.
XST_SUCCESS on success.
XST_NO_DATA if there was no data in the mailbox.
On success, the number of bytes read is returned through the pointer. The call may return with fewer bytes placed in the buffer than requested (not including zero). This is not necessarily an error condition and indicates the amount of data that was currently available in the mailbox.

briefdescription.para: Reads requested bytes from the mailbox, blocking until complete.

detaileddescription.para: Reads requested bytes from the mailbox referenced by InstancePtr, into the buffer pointed to by the provided pointer. The number of bytes must be a multiple of 4 (bytes). If not, the call fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.
Buffer to read the mailbox contents into, aligned to a word boundary.
Number of bytes of data requested.

simplesect.para: The call blocks until the number of bytes requested are available.

briefdescription.para: Writes requested bytes to the mailbox.

detaileddescription.para: Writes the requested bytes from the buffer pointed to by the provided pointer into the mailbox referenced by InstancePtr. The number of bytes must be a multiple of 4 (bytes). If not, the call fails in an assert.
This function is non blocking.

InstancePtr
Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.
BufferPtr
Source data buffer, aligned to a word boundary.
RequestedBytes
Number of bytes requested to be written.
BytesSentPtr
Points to memory which is updated with the actual number of bytes written, return value.
XST_SUCCESS on success.
XST_FIFO_NO_ROOM if the FIFO was full.
On success, the number of bytes successfully written into the destination mailbox is returned in the provided pointer. The call may return with zero. This is not necessarily an error condition and indicates that the mailbox is currently full.

simplesect.para: The provided buffer pointed to by BufferPtr must be aligned to a word boundary.

briefdescription.para: Writes requested bytes to the mailbox, blocking until complete.

detaileddescription.para: Writes the requested bytes from the buffer pointed to by the provided pointer into the mailbox referenced by InstancePtr. The number of bytes must be a multiple of 4 (bytes). If not, the call fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.
Source data buffer, aligned to a word boundary.
Number of bytes requested to be written.

simplesect.para: The call blocks until the number of bytes requested are written. The provided buffer pointed to by BufferPtr must be aligned to a word boundary.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether mailbox receive data is available.

detaileddescription.para: Checks to see if there is data available to be read.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.

listitem.para: FALSE if there is data to be read.
TRUE if there is no data to be read.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether the mailbox write FIFO is full.

detaileddescription.para: Checks to see if there is room in the write FIFO.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.

listitem.para: FALSE if there is room in write FIFO.
TRUE if there is no room in the write FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Flushes mailbox FIFOs by draining the read FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: Resets the mailbox FIFOs by emptying the READ FIFO and making sure the Error Status is zero.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if there are any outstanding errors.

simplesect.para: Data from read FIFO is thrown away.

briefdescription.para: Resets mailbox FIFOs through the hardware control register.

detaileddescription.para: Resets the mailbox FIFOs by clearing the READ and WRITE FIFOs using the hardware control register for memory mapped IO.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMbox instance to be worked on.

simplesect.para: Use XMbox_Flush instead for FSL based access.

briefdescription.para: Sets the mailbox interrupt enable register.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the interrupt enable register for this mailbox. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance to be worked on.
Logical OR of XMB_IX_* constants found in xmbox_hw.h.

briefdescription.para: Gets the mailbox interrupt enable mask.

detaileddescription.para: Retrieves the interrupt enable for the mailbox. AND the result of this function with XMB_IX_* to determine which interrupts of this mailbox are enabled. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance to be worked on.

simplesect.para: Mask of interrupt bits made up of XMB_IX_* constants found in xmbox_hw.h.

briefdescription.para: Gets the mailbox interrupt status mask.

detaileddescription.para: Retrieve the interrupt status for the mailbox. AND the results of this function with XMB_IX_* to determine which interrupts are currently pending to the processor. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance to be worked on.

simplesect.para: Mask of interrupt bits made up of XMB_IX_* constants found in xmbox_hw.h.

detaileddescription.para: Clears pending interrupts with the provided mask. This function should be called after the software has serviced the interrupts that are pending. This function clears the corresponding bits of the Interrupt Status Register. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance to be worked on.
Logical OR of XMB_IX_* constants found in xmbox_hw.h.

detaileddescription.para:
Returns Status register contents. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.
InstancePtr
Pointer to the instance to be worked on.
Value returns Status Register contents.
Sets the Send Interrupt Threshold. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance to be worked on.
Value to set for the SIT. Only lower Log2(FIFO Depth) bits are used.

detaileddescription.para:
Set the Receive Interrupt Threshold. This function can only be used for Non-FSL interface. If not, the function fails in an assert.
InstancePtr
Pointer to the instance to be worked on.
Value
Value to set for the RIT. Only lower Log2(FIFO Depth) bits are used.

briefdescription.para: Looks up mailbox configuration by device ID or base address.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the unique device ID/BaseAddress. The XMbox_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

parameterdescription.para: Contains the base address of the device.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found or NULL if the specified device ID/BaseAddress was not found. See xmbox.h for the definition of XMbox_Config.
In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.
